newsitem.title: USA: BEA starts four open-end funds.
newsitem.headline: BEA starts four open-end funds.

text.p: BEA Associates, a unit of CS Holding's Credit Suisse subsidiary, said it launched four new no-load, open-end mutual funds, under the moniker BEA Advisor Funds.
The four include: BEA International Equity Fund, BEA Emerging Markets Equity Fund, BEA High Yield Fund, and BEA Telecommunications Fund.

The four funds will be available through broker-dealers, investment advisers, banks, financial planners, and insurance companies. BEA currently has total assets of about $1.6 billion in 11 closed-end funds.
